### River Mile 6 Instream Temperature

Currently 2012-04-23 - 2025-10-17

**Notes**
Rivermile 6 has between 1 and 3 loggers in the stream at any given day/time. The data is process as the average between all loggers with data for each year. 

```{r include=FALSE}
monitoring_location_id <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw","historical-temperature", "2023_UDWC_WQM-ContTemp-_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "Monitoring_Locations")
# 2025

# TODO: for 2024 and 2025 - there are three sheets with 006-00 (WC_006-00_21629136, WC_006-00_21555606, WC_006-00_21564982)
# Should I pull all of them and average - yes? 
rm6_2025_raw_1 <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw", "historical-temperature",  "2025_UDWC_Continuous_Temperature_Data_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006-00_21629136", skip = 3) |> 
  select(date = DATE, time = TIME, temperature = TEMP_r) |> 
  mutate(date = date + hms::as_hms(format(time, "%H:%M:%S"))) |> 
  select(date, temperature) |> glimpse()

rm6_2025_raw_2 <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw", "historical-temperature",  "2025_UDWC_Continuous_Temperature_Data_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006-00_21555606", skip = 3) |> 
  select(date = DATE, time = TIME,temperature = TEMP_r) |> 
  mutate(date = date + hms::as_hms(format(time, "%H:%M:%S"))) |> 
  select(date, temperature) |> glimpse()

rm6_2025_raw_3 <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data-raw", "historical-temperature",  "2025_UDWC_Continuous_Temperature_Data_FINAL.xlsx"), sheet = "WC_006-00_21564982", skip = 3) |> 
  select(date = DATE, time = TIME, temperature = TEMP_r) |> 
  mutate(date = date + hms::as_hms(format(time, "%H:%M:%S"))) |> 
  select(date, temperature) |> glimpse()

rm6_2025_raw <- bind_rows(
  rm6_2025_raw_1,
  rm6_2025_raw_2,
  rm6_2025_raw_3) |>
  summarise(temperature = mean(temperature, na.rm = TRUE), .by = date)

                           rm6_2013_raw,
                           rm6_2014_raw,
                           rm6_2015_raw,
                           rm6_2016_raw,
                           rm6_2017_raw,
                           rm6_2018_raw,
                           rm6_2019_raw,
                           rm6_2020_raw,
                           rm6_2021_raw_2) |> 
  select(date, temperature)

all_rm_6_dates_and_times <- bind_rows(rm6_2025_2022,
                                rm6_2012_2021) |> 
  filter(!is.na(date))

rm6_full_2012_2025 <- all_rm_6_dates_and_times |>
  mutate(date = lubridate::floor_date(date, "1 day")) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarize(
    mean   = mean(temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    max    = max(temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    min    = min(temperature, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    `7DADM` = zoo::rollapply(max, width = 7, FUN = mean, fill = NA, align = "right")
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean:min, `7DADM`), values_to = "temperature", names_to = "statistic") |> glimpse()

rm_6_historical <- rm6_full_2012_2025

usethis::use_data(rm_6_historical, overwrite = T)
usethis::use_data(all_rm_6_dates_and_times, overwrite = T)
```

```{r}
rm_6_historical |> 
  group_by(year = year(date)) |> 
  summarise(mean_temperature = mean(temperature, na.rm = T),
            min_temperature = min(temperature, na.rm = T),
            max_temperature = max(temperature, na.rm = T)) |> 
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)

ggplot() + 
  geom_line(data = rm_6_historical, aes(x = date, y = temperature, color = statistic)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_small) +
  theme_minimal()

```

### Camp Polk Instream Temperature and Discharge

Currently pulled from OWRD '2011-05-01' - 2026-03-29

```{r eval=FALSE}
cp_daily_mean_temperature <-  get_owrd_hydro(
  station_nbr = "14076100",
  start_date = '2011-05-01',
  end_date = Sys.Date()-1,
  data_source = "WTEMP_MEAN"
) |> 
  rename(value = daily_mean_water_temp_c) |> 
  mutate(variable = "water temperature (c)",
         statistic = "mean",
         location = "camp polk") |> 
  glimpse()


cp_daily_min_temperature <-  get_owrd_hydro(
  station_nbr = "14076100",
  start_date = '2011-05-01',
  end_date = Sys.Date()-1,
  data_source = "WTEMP_MIN"
) |> 
  rename(value = daily_min_water_temp_f) |> 
  mutate(variable = "water temperature (c)",
         statistic = "min",
         location = "camp polk") |> 
  select(-time_observed) |> 
  glimpse()

cp_daily_max_temperature <-  get_owrd_hydro(
  station_nbr = "14076100",
  start_date = '2011-05-01',
  end_date = Sys.Date()-1,
  data_source = "WTEMP_MAX"
) |> 
  rename(value = daily_max_water_temp_c) |> 
  mutate(variable = "water temperature (c)",
         statistic = "max",
         location = "camp polk") |> 
  select(-time_observed) |> 
  glimpse()

cp_mean_daily_flow <-  get_owrd_hydro(
  station_nbr = "14076100",
  start_date = '2011-05-01',
  end_date = Sys.Date()-1,
  data_source = "MDF"
) |> 
  rename(value = mean_daily_flow_cfs) |> 
  mutate(variable = "discharge (cfs)",
         statistic = "mean",
         location = "camp polk") |> 
  glimpse()

camp_polk_historical_raw <- bind_rows(
  cp_daily_max_temperature,
  cp_daily_min_temperature,
  cp_daily_mean_temperature,
  cp_mean_daily_flow
) |> 
  rename(date = record_date) |> 
  mutate(date = as.Date(
    parse_date_time(date, orders = c("mdy", "mdy HM"))
  )) |> 
  glimpse()

camp_polk_historical <- camp_polk_historical_raw |>
  filter(statistic == "max") |>
  filter(variable == "water temperature (c)") |> 
  arrange(date) |>
  mutate(value = zoo::rollapply(value, width = 7, FUN = mean,
                                      fill = NA, align = "right"),
         statistic = "7DADM") |> 
  bind_rows(camp_polk_historical_raw) |> 
  arrange(date)

camp_polk_flow_historical <- camp_polk_historical_raw |> 
  filter(variable == "discharge (cfs)") |> 
  select(date, flow_cfs = value, statistic) |> 
  arrange(date) |> 
  glimpse()

usethis::use_data(camp_polk_flow_historical, overwrite = T)

```

```{r}
whychusModel::camp_polk_historical |> 
  group_by(year = year(date), statistic, variable) |> 
  summarise(n_values = n()) |> 
  knitr::kable()

ggplot() + 
  geom_line(data = whychusModel::camp_polk_historical, aes(x = date, y = value, color = statistic)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_small) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y") + 
  theme_minimal()

```

### Whychus Cr Near Sisters - Instream Temperature and Flow

This site is located upstream of Sisters. It collects temperature and flow. 

Currently pulled from OWRD 2015-10-01 - 2026-04-14

```{r eval=FALSE}
wns_daily_mean_temperature <-  get_owrd_hydro(
  station_nbr = "14075000",
  start_date = '2011-01-01',
  end_date = Sys.Date(),
  data_source = "WTEMP_MEAN"
) |> 
  rename(value = daily_mean_water_temp_c) |> 
  mutate(variable = "water temperature (c)",
         statistic = "mean",
         location = "whychus cr nr sisters, or") |> 
  glimpse()


wns_daily_min_temperature <-  get_owrd_hydro(
  station_nbr = "14075000",
  start_date = '2011-01-01',
  end_date = Sys.Date(),
  data_source = "WTEMP_MIN"
) |> 
  rename(value = daily_min_water_temp_f) |> 
  mutate(variable = "water temperature (c)",
         statistic = "min",
         location = "whychus cr nr sisters, or") |> 
  select(-time_observed) |> 
  glimpse()

wns_daily_max_temperature <-  get_owrd_hydro(
  station_nbr = "14075000",
  start_date = '2011-01-01',
  end_date = Sys.Date(),
  data_source = "WTEMP_MAX"
) |> 
  rename(value = daily_max_water_temp_c) |> 
  mutate(variable = "water temperature (c)",
         statistic = "max",
         location = "whychus cr nr sisters, or") |> 
  select(-time_observed) |> 
  glimpse()

wns_mean_daily_flow <-  get_owrd_hydro(
  station_nbr = "14075000",
  start_date = '2011-01-01',
  end_date = Sys.Date(),
  data_source = "MDF"
) |> 
  rename(value = mean_daily_flow_cfs) |> 
  mutate(variable = "discharge (cfs)",

         location = "whychus cr nr sisters, or") |> 
  glimpse()

whychus_nr_sisters_historical <- bind_rows(
  wns_daily_max_temperature,
  wns_daily_min_temperature,
  wns_daily_mean_temperature,
  wns_mean_daily_flow
) |>
```

### Historical weather forecasts

Historical NWS weather forecasts were obtained from the [Open-Meteo Historical Forecast API](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/historical-forecast-api), which archives operational GFS (Global Forecast System) model output — the same underlying model used by NWS to generate official forecasts. While NWS applies additional post-processing (Model Output Statistics and forecaster adjustments) before issuing public forecasts, the raw GFS output accessed through Open-Meteo represents the same meteorological signal and is expected to differ from official NWS values by only 1–3°C on any given day. For the purposes of this analysis, GFS-based forecasts are considered a suitable proxy for NWS forecast inputs given their shared model foundation and the daily temporal resolution of the model.

```{r eval=FALSE}
# Single month test — run this first
one_month_historical <- get_historical_forecast(
  lat        = 44.390278,
  lon        = -121.406792,
  start_date = "2023-07-01",
  end_date   = "2023-07-31",
  lead_days  = c(1, 3, 7)
)

glimpse(one_month_historical)

# Historical forecast data from 2019-12-25 onwards (GFS archived model runs)
historical_forecast_data <- get_historical_forecast_range(
  lat        = 44.390278,
  lon        = -121.406792,
  start_date = "2019-01-01",
  end_date   = Sys.Date()-1,
  lead_days  = c(1, 3, 7),
  save_dir   = "data-raw/historical_forecasts"
) |>
  mutate(type = "historical forecast")

# Historical observed weather from 2011-01-01 to 2019-12-24 (ERA5 reanalysis)
# Uses same variables/schema as forecast data; issue_date and lead_days are NA
historical_weather_data <- get_historical_weather(
  lat        = 44.390278,
  lon        = -121.406792,
  start_date = "2011-01-01",
  end_date   = "2018-12-31"
) |>
  mutate(type = "historical weather")

all_historical_forecasts <- bind_rows(
  historical_weather_data,
  historical_forecast_data
) |>
  arrange(variable, valid_date)

usethis::use_data(all_historical_forecasts, overwrite = T)

```
```{r echo=FALSE}
all_historical_forecasts |> 
  group_by(variable, type) |> 
  summarise(min_date = min(valid_date, na.rm = T),
            max_date = max(valid_date, na.rm = T),
            lead_days = paste0(unique(lead_days), collapse = ", "),
            n_NA = length(unique(is.na(value))) + length(unique(is.infinite(value)))) |> 
  knitr::kable()

```

```{r echo=FALSE}
plot_data <- all_historical_forecasts |>
  mutate(
    month     = month(valid_date, label = TRUE),
    year      = year(valid_date),
    lead_days = factor(lead_days, levels = c(0, 1, 3, 7),
                       labels = c("Hist. Weather",  "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
    variable  = recode(variable,
                       "temperature_2m_max" = "Max air temp (°C)",
                       "temperature_2m_min" = "Min air temp (°C)",
                       "cloud_cover_mean"   = "Cloud cover (%)"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(month, variable, lead_days) |>
  summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# --- Colors -------------------------------------------------------------

lead_colors <- c(
  "Hist. Weather" = "darkgreen",
  "Day 1" = "#E24B4A",
  "Day 3" = "#888780",
  "Day 7" = "#378ADD"
)

# --- Plot ---------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = month, y = mean_value,
                      color = lead_days, group = lead_days)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = lead_colors, name = "Lead time") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    title    = "GFS historical forecast and weather — 44.39°N, 121.41°W",
    subtitle = "Monthly mean by forecast lead time, 2011–present",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = NULL,
    caption  = "Source: Open-Meteo Historical Forecast API (GFS seamless)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position  = "top",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40"),
    plot.caption     = element_text(color = "grey60", size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing    = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )
```

```{r}
overlap <- inner_join(
  camp_polk_logger_historical |> 
    filter(statistic == "max") |> 
    mutate(date = as.Date(date)),
  camp_polk_historical |> 
    filter(statistic == "max") |> 
    filter(variable == "water temperature (c)") |> 
    select(date, value),

)

overlap |>
  mutate(diff = temperature - value) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_diff = mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_diff  = max(abs(diff), na.rm = TRUE),
    cor       = cor(temperature, value, use = "complete.obs")
  )
```

### Historical air temperature data - Sisters, OR

```{r}
# Pull historical daily air temperature data near Sisters, OR
# Uses GridMET via the climateR package (~4km gridded, 1979-present, no API key needed)
#
# Sisters, OR coordinates: 44.2896 N, 121.5491 W
#
# Install:
# install.packages("remotes")
# remotes::install_github("mikejohnson51/climateR")
# install.packages(c("sf", "dplyr"))

library(climateR)  # getGridMET()
library(sf)        # st_as_sf(), st_point()
library(dplyr)     # mutate(), rename()

# ── Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

START_DATE  <- "1979-01-01"
END_DATE    <- "2025-12-31"
OUTPUT_PATH <- "sisters_air_temp.csv"
# Temperature threshold for rain/snow partitioning (degrees C)
# Precip is classified as snow when tavg_C <= SNOW_THRESH
SNOW_THRESH <- 0
# ── Define location as sf point ───────────────────────────────────────────────

sisters_pt <- sf::st_as_sf(
  data.frame(site = "Sisters_OR", lon = -121.5491, lat = 44.2896),
  coords = c("lon", "lat"),
  crs = 4326
)

# ── Pull GridMET data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# varname options for temperature: "tmmx" (max), "tmmn" (min)
# GridMET stores temperature in Kelvin

raw <- climateR::getGridMET(
  AOI       = sisters_pt,
  varname   = c("tmmx", "tmmn", "pr"),
  startDate = START_DATE,
  endDate   = END_DATE
)

# ── Clean and convert units ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# GridMET returns a data.frame when AOI is a point

# Air temperature
sisters_air_temp_historical <- raw |>
  dplyr::rename(date = date, tmax_K = tmmx, tmin_K = tmmn) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    date   = as.Date(date),
    tmax_C = tmax_K - 273.15,
    tmin_C = tmin_K - 273.15,
    tavg_C = (tmax_C + tmin_C) / 2,
    tmax_F = tmax_C * 1.8 + 32,
    tmin_F = tmin_C * 1.8 + 32,
    tavg_F = tavg_C * 1.8 + 32
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(date, tmax_C, tmin_C, tavg_C, tmax_F, tmin_F, tavg_F)

# Save
usethis::use_data(sisters_air_temp_historical, overwrite = T)

# Precip
sisters_precip_historical <- raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    date        = as.Date(date),
    tmax_C      = tmmx - 273.15,
    tmin_C      = tmmn - 273.15,
    tavg_C      = (tmax_C + tmin_C) / 2,
    precip_mm   = pr,
    snow_mm     = dplyr::if_else(tavg_C <= SNOW_THRESH, precip_mm, 0),
    rain_mm     = dplyr::if_else(tavg_C >  SNOW_THRESH, precip_mm, 0)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(date, precip_mm, rain_mm, snow_mm)

# Save
usethis::use_data(sisters_precip_historical, overwrite = T)
```
